text: In 1, Sarvesh settled in Rootechoed.
translation: 在 1年，薩維石 定居於 根之回聲。

text: In the midspring of 6, Sarvesh attacked the goblin Nguslu Hatehowl.
translation: 在6年的仲春，薩維石攻擊了哥布林 恩古斯魯·仇恨嚎叫。

text: In the midwinter of 13, a papaya wood scepter was stolen from Flightempire by Sarvesh during The Rampage of the dragon Sarvesh Warmthpearls the Fire of Vaults in Flightempire and brought to Rootechoed.
translation: 在13年的仲冬時節，一根木瓜木權杖在巨龍薩維石「火庫之暖珠」於飛翔帝國發動的「狂暴」期間，被薩維石從飛翔帝國偷走，並被帶到了根之回聲。

text: In the midwinter of 15, Sarvesh attacked The Crowded Curse at Fortresswitches.
translation: 在15年的仲冬時節，薩維石襲擊了位於女巫堡的擁擠詛咒。

text: In the midwinter of 15, Sarvesh struck down the goblin Båx Clasheddemon in Fortresswitches.
translation: 在15年的仲冬時節，薩維石擊倒了位於女巫堡的哥布林巴克斯·交鋒惡魔。

text: In the midwinter of 15, Sarvesh struck down the goblin Bosa Terrorplain in Fortresswitches.
translation: 在15年的仲冬時節，薩維石擊倒了位於女巫堡的哥布林波薩·恐懼平原。

text: In the early autumn of 19, Sarvesh became an enemy of The Fondled Tongs.
translation: 在19年的初秋，薩維石成為了撫摸之鉗的敵人。

text: In the early spring of 17, Sarvesh devoured a black-crested gibbon of The Beard of Evenness in Flightempire.
translation: 在17年的初春，薩維石在飛翔帝國吞食了一隻均衡之鬚的黑冠長臂猿。

text: In the late autumn of 30, Sarvesh attacked The Autumnal Road at Sombertraded.
translation: 在30年的深秋，薩維石襲擊了位於陰鬱交易的秋日之路。

text: In the late autumn of 30, the dwarf Medtob Merchantanvils's thumb, right hand was torn off by Sarvesh.
translation: 在30年的深秋，矮人梅德托布·商人鐵砧的右手拇指被薩維石扯斷了。

text: In the early spring of 90, the allosaurus woman Sabresmoothness fought with Behal. While defeated, the latter escaped unscathed.
translation: 在90年的初春，異特龍女薩布林斯穆斯與貝哈爾發生了戰鬥。儘管後者戰敗，卻毫髮無傷地逃脫了。

text: An elusive medium-sized fish found in coastal waters.
translation: 一種難以捉摸的中型魚類，棲息於沿海水域。

text: An orange striped person with the head of a tiger.
translation: 一個帶有虎頭部的橘色條紋人。

text: An aquatic person in the shape of an orca with arms.
translation: 一種具有手臂、外形如逆戟鯨的水生生物。

text: An insidious form of vermin.  It lives only to steal food from others.
translation: 一種陰險的害蟲。牠活著只為了從他人那裡偷取食物。

text: An insect many times the size of its peers.  It is known for its deafening buzz.
translation: 一種體型遠大於同類的昆蟲。它以其震耳欲聾的嗡嗡聲而聞名。

text: An oceanic fish.
translation: 一種海洋魚類。

text: An invertebrate found off the coast.  It has a sting which can be severe.
translation: 一種在海岸外發現的無脊椎動物。牠擁有能造成嚴重傷害的螫刺。

text: An evil monster from the swamp.  It resembles a knot of waterlogged weeds but will strike the unaware victim.
translation: 一隻來自沼澤的邪惡怪物。它看起來像一團浸水的雜草，但會襲擊毫無防備的受害者。

text: An animal person with the head of the amphibious olm.  It lives underground near water.
translation: 一種擁有兩棲洞螈頭部的動物人。牠棲息於地底靠近水源的地方。

text: An evil humanoid with a long tail, black spiky fur and a twitching nose.  It lives far underground.
translation: 一種邪惡的人形生物，有著長尾巴、黑色尖刺狀的毛皮和抽動的鼻子。它居住在遙遠的地下。

text: An orange person with the head and tail of a lion tamarin.
translation: 一個擁有獅狨猴頭部與尾巴的橘色人。

text: An aquatic arthropod with a wide head and tapering body.
translation: 一種頭部寬闊、身體逐漸變細的水生節肢動物。

text: An aquatic arthropod with a pronounced head structure and frontal appendages for filter feeding.  It is large for an arthropod.
translation: 一種水生節肢動物，具有顯著的頭部結構和用於濾食的額部附肢。以節肢動物而言，牠體型巨大。

text: An arthropod person with the pronounced head shape of an aegirocassis.
translation: 一種節肢動物人，有著海神盔蝦那樣顯著的頭部形狀。
